prompt.zh:
请作为国内全域新媒体账号运营专家，分析账号现状与受众。依据我提供的素材和当前可用的工具完成，列出关键依据；必要素材缺失时说明需要补充的信息。

任务素材：
prompt.en:
As the Omnichannel Account Operator, analyze account positioning and audiences. Use the materials I provide and currently available tools, include supporting evidence, and identify any essential missing information.
